flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/vaEverythingRight">
  <question>Is everything right?</question>
  <input type="boolean">
    <option value="true">Yes, everything is right</option>
    <option value="false">No, something needs correcting</option>
  </input>
</fg-set>

<fg-set path="/vaCorrectionTarget">
  <question>What needs correcting?</question>
  <input type="enum" options-path="/vaCorrectionTargetOptions">
    <option value="dateOfBirth">My date of birth</option>
    <option value="w2">A W-2 from my employer</option>
    <option value="records">A payment Virginia's records show (Lines 20 to 22)</option>
  </input>
</fg-set>

<fg-set path="/vaDeclaration">
  <question>Your declaration</question>
  <hint>Form 760 is signed under penalty of law.</hint>
  <input type="multi-enum" options-path="/vaDeclarationOptions">
    <option value="signed">I declare that this return is true, correct and complete to the best of my knowledge, including my answers about where I lived, military pay, Commonwealth Savers contributions and untaxed purchases.</option>
  </input>
</fg-set>

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction, maximum
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): up to $15,000 of military basic pay, reduced $1 for each $1 of basic pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 38.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction, maximum</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): up to $15,000 of military basic pay, reduced $1 for
        each $1 of basic pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. 2024 Form 760
        instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 38.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>

  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Primary filer has attained age 70
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to the $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 for tax year 2024 (/vaCommonwealthSaversAge70BirthDateCutoff). Reads the exported date of birth. The contributions are asked of the primary filer only, so the spouse's age does not enter.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerAge70OrOlder">
  <Name>Primary filer has attained age 70</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(7)(b): a contributor who has attained age 70 is not subject to the
        $4,000 limit. Born on or before December 31, 1954 for tax year 2024
        (/vaCommonwealthSaversAge70BirthDateCutoff). Reads the exported date of birth. The
        contributions are asked of the primary filer only, so the spouse's age does not enter.</Description>
  <Derived>

      </Left>

  </Derived>

facts.name: City or county the filer lived in on January 1, 2025
facts.description: Form 760 header, "Locality Code"; 2024 instructions page 14: "the locality in which you lived on January 1, 2025 ... Local school funding is allocated based in part on this information." Asked and confirmed by the filer: the federal address gives a city name and a ZIP, but a ZIP can straddle localities and the date is the day after the tax year. When the ZIP lies in one locality, website-static/js/virginia-locality.js fills this in from it, and the filer confirms it.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaLocality">
  <Name>City or county the filer lived in on January 1, 2025</Name>
  <Description>Form 760 header, "Locality Code"; 2024 instructions page 14: "the locality in which you
        lived on January 1, 2025 ... Local school funding is allocated based in part on this
        information." Asked and confirmed by the filer: the federal address gives a city name and a
        ZIP, but a ZIP can straddle localities and the date is the day after the tax year. When the
        ZIP lies in one locality, website-static/js/virginia-locality.js fills this in from it, and
        the filer confirms it.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Enum optionsPath="/vaLocalityOptions"/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 35, amount you owe
facts.description: Line 27 plus Line 34 when there is tax owed; otherwise Line 34 less the overpayment on Line 28 when that is positive. Line 34 here is the use tax alone: Lines 29 to 32 (overpayment credited to next year, voluntary contributions, penalty and interest) are out of scope.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAmountYouOwe">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 35, amount you owe</Name>
  <Description>Line 27 plus Line 34 when there is tax owed; otherwise Line 34 less the overpayment on
        Line 28 when that is positive. Line 34 here is the use tax alone: Lines 29 to 32 (overpayment
        credited to next year, voluntary contributions, penalty and interest) are out of scope.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Add>
            <Dependency module="virginiaPayments" path="/vaTaxYouOwe"/>
            <Dependency path="/vaUseTax"/>
          </Add>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency module="virginiaPayments" path="/vaOverpayment"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: What can be corrected here
facts.description: The three things the prototype lets a filer correct on the Virginia side: the date of birth (a fact the filer stated), a W-2 (a document, corrected as a whole) and a payment Virginia's records show (Lines 20 to 22, the records stand-in). Calculated amounts are never editable.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCorrectionTargetOptions">
  <Name>What can be corrected here</Name>
  <Description>The three things the prototype lets a filer correct on the Virginia side: the date
        of birth (a fact the filer stated), a W-2 (a document, corrected as a whole) and a payment
        Virginia's records show (Lines 20 to 22, the records stand-in). Calculated amounts are never
        editable.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <EnumOptions>
      <String>dateOfBirth</String>
      <String>w2</String>
      <String>records</String>
    </EnumOptions>
  </Derived>
</Fact>
